description: This file contains unit tests for the Orleans membership table operations using PostgreSQL as the storage backend. It includes test methods for initialization, CRUD operations, gateway retrieval, and cleanup, all scoped to the PostgreSQL implementation.

classes.name: PostgreSqlMembershipTableTests
classes.description: Unit test class for PostgreSQL-backed Orleans membership table operations. Extends MembershipTableTestsBase and contains specific tests for PostgreSQL implementation.

methods.name: CreateFilters
methods.description: Creates and configures logger filter options with Trace level for the test class.

methods.name: CreateMembershipTable
methods.description: Creates an IMembershipTable instance configured for PostgreSQL using provided logger.

methods.name: CreateGatewayListProvider
methods.description: Creates an IGatewayListProvider for PostgreSQL clustering client.

methods.name: GetAdoInvariant
methods.description: Returns the ADO.NET invariant name for PostgreSQL.

methods.name: GetConnectionString
methods.description: Asynchronously retrieves the connection string for the test database instance.
